description: This file defines the interface for a diff library used in a version control system, including data structures, function prototypes, and constants related to diff operations, options, and output formatting.

classes.name: combine_diff_path
classes.description: Represents a path in a combined diff, including parent information and object ID.

classes.name: combine_diff_parent
classes.description: Represents a parent in a combined diff, including status, mode, object ID, and path.

classes.name: diffstat_file
classes.description: Stores information about a file's diff statistics, including name, added/deleted lines, and flags.

methods.name: diff_tree_paths
methods.description: Generates diff paths for a tree object.

methods.name: diff_tree_oid
methods.description: Computes diff between two object IDs with a base path.

methods.name: diff_root_tree_oid
methods.description: Computes diff for the root tree object.

methods.name: diff_set_mnemonic_prefix
methods.description: Sets mnemonic prefixes for diff output.

methods.name: diff_set_noprefix
methods.description: Removes prefixes from diff output.

methods.name: diff_set_default_prefix
methods.description: Sets default prefixes for diff output.

methods.name: diff_can_quit_early
methods.description: Checks if diff operation can be terminated early based on options.

methods.name: diff_queue_addremove
methods.description: Queues a file addition or removal in the diff queue.

methods.name: diff_queue_change
methods.description: Queues a file modification in the diff queue.

methods.name: diff_addremove
methods.description: Stages a file addition or removal.

methods.name: diff_change
methods.description: Stages a file modification.

methods.name: diff_same
methods.description: Marks a file as unchanged.

methods.name: diff_unmerge
methods.description: Handles unmerged files.

methods.name: compute_diffstat
methods.description: Calculates diff statistics for a set of diff entries.

methods.name: diff_filter_bit
methods.description: Returns filter bits for a given diff status.

methods.name: diff_get_color
methods.description: Retrieves color codes for diff output.

methods.name: diff_line_prefix
methods.description: Returns the line prefix for diff output.

methods.name: diff_tree_combined
methods.description: Generates a combined diff for a tree object.

methods.name: diff_tree_combined_merge
methods.description: Merges combined diffs for a commit.

methods.name: diff_check_follow_pathspec
methods.description: Checks if a pathspec supports --follow mode.

methods.name: diff_result_code
methods.description: Returns the result code of a diff operation.

methods.name: diff_no_index
methods.description: Performs diff ignoring index.

methods.name: index_differs_from
methods.description: Checks if index differs from a given state.

methods.name: show_interdiff
methods.description: Displays an interdiff between two object IDs.
